explanation: CS4246 and CS4278 require CS3263 or CS3243 completed strictly earlier. Neither is completed, and CS3263 is required in remaining semester 1, so neither dependent course can be taken in semester 1 as requested. Also, mandatory simultaneous enrollment in CS2101 with CS2103T makes the required semester-1 load 20 units (CS2101, CS2103T, CS3263, CS4246, CS4278), exceeding the 16-unit maximum.
